zh: 从第 k 分钟开始，每一分钟都要看最近 k 分钟的平均值；相邻两分钟的窗口只差进出各一个元素，适合滑动窗口。
平均值 s/k 严格大于阈值，等价于窗口和 s 严格大于 threshold × k。这样全程只用整数比较，避免浮点误差和整数除法截断带来的错误。
维护窗口和 s：每分钟 i 加上 numCalls[i]，若 i ≥ k 再减去 numCalls[i−k]；当 i ≥ k−1（窗口已满）且 s > threshold × k 时警报数加一；最后输出警报数。窗口和与 threshold × k 都可能到 10^10，用 64 位整数。
en: From minute k on, every minute looks at the average of the last k minutes; consecutive windows differ by one element entering and one leaving, which suits a sliding window.

The average s/k being strictly greater than the threshold is equivalent to the window sum s being strictly greater than threshold * k. That keeps everything in integer comparisons and avoids floating-point error and truncating integer division.

Maintain the window sum s: at minute i add numCalls[i], and if i >= k also subtract numCalls[i-k]; when i >= k-1 (the window is full) and s > threshold * k, count one alert; print the count. Both the window sum and threshold * k can reach 10^10, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Problem

At minute T (counting from 1), the average is taken over the call volumes of the k minutes T−(k−1)..T (k=precedingMinutes); an alert is raised once when the average is strictly greater than alertThreshold. When T<k the window is incomplete and no alert is raised. Find the total number of alerts.

## Approach

Use a sliding window to maintain the sum s of the call volumes over the last k minutes. The average s/k>threshold is equivalent to s>threshold·k; compare everything with 64-bit integers to avoid errors from floating point and integer division.

## Correctness

The window becomes complete only from T=k, and each T is checked exactly once. Multiplying both sides of the inequality by the positive number k does not change the order, so the comparison agrees exactly with comparing the real-valued average.

## Complexity

O(n). The window sum is at most 10^10 and threshold·k is at most 10^10, so 64 bits are needed.

## Independent verification

The oracle computes, for each T, the exact average as a fraction and compares it with the threshold (O(nk), small data only), without using a sliding sum or moving terms across the inequality. Every combination with n=1..5, k=1..n, call volumes 0..3 and thresholds 1..3 was enumerated and the reference program was actually run on each. The wrong solutions cover integer division, alerting on equality, computing before the window is full, and 32-bit accumulation.
